scripts.build: bun run --filter onpurpose build && bun run --filter docs build
scripts.size: bun run --filter onpurpose build && cd packages/onpurpose && bun x size-limit
scripts.publint: bun run --filter onpurpose build && cd packages/onpurpose && bun x publint
scripts.attw: bun run --filter onpurpose build && cd packages/onpurpose && bun x attw --pack . --profile esm-only
scripts.release: bun run --filter onpurpose build && changeset publish
